summary.text: Will Brownsberger is a Democratic state senator who has represented the Suffolk and Middlesex District since 2012 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He faces Brandon Charles Wood, an unenrolled candidate, and previously served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives from 2007 to 2012.

paragraphs.text: William Brownsberger was born in Boston and lives in Belmont, Massachusetts.
He earned a B.A. in 1978 and a J.D. in 1983, both from Harvard University.

His career experience includes work as a defense attorney, as associate director for public policy of the Harvard Medical School Division on Addictions, and as a senior criminal justice advisor with Join Together.
Brownsberger represented the 24th Middlesex District in the state House from 2007 to 2012, then moved to the Senate.

In 2025-2026 he chairs the Senate Committee on the Census and also serves on the Senate Rules Committee, the Steering and Policy Committee, and the joint committees on Housing, Rules and Transportation.
